description: Translate text and files locally without metered translation API tokens.

defaultPrompt: Translate this into French locally without using API tokens.
Translate this Markdown document into German and keep its formatting.
Translate these SRT subtitles into Spanish and preserve every timestamp.
interface.longDescription: Translate text, Markdown, plain-text documents, and SRT subtitles accurately with Yaps desktop 2.1.0 or newer. The translation engine runs entirely on your computer: it does not upload the source, call a hosted translation API, or consume metered cloud translation/API tokens. Preserve Markdown structure, code blocks, image embeds, subtitle timestamps, and cue indices while writing a new file that never changes the source. The plugin checks the Yaps version, sign-in, free-trial or Yaps Pro access, language support, and the installed local translation engine first. Requires a local-capable ChatGPT Desktop Work or Codex session; ChatGPT web and cloud sessions cannot reach the installed Yaps engine. Users can also run the feature directly in Yaps.

name: yaps-translation
